instances.claim: This tells me that CENTS consists of a bounded set of individual Cents — a group of works with fixed membership — that began identical to one another.
instances.why: Line 10's 'Every Cent' and line 19's 'Each object, initially identical' are claims about a population, but the only things the draft has introduced are a single chosen readymade (lines 3, 5) and the five hundred billion circulating Lincoln cents (line 4) — and that latter set is plainly not the one whose members each pass through five transformations or bear marks of touch. The collection both lines quantify over is never established, so the quantifiers read as fully formed while pointing at nothing the draft counted.

instances.claim: This tells me that the object was in the process of ceasing to exist, and survived only because its context held it up.
instances.why: 'Remained' and 'buoyed into physicality' are continuations that presuppose a prior state of threat or dissolution, and no earlier line puts the object's physical existence in question — lines 1–4 establish a price discrepancy and a reproduction count. Line 6's 'dissolve into worthlessness' is about value rather than physicality, and comes afterwards in any case.
